title: Sag says "I'm not looking"
old_caption: Sagittarius is a free spirit on a solo trip with no ties, and somehow packed two mugs and two scarves. For balance. Which sign do you know is looking while saying they're not?

title: Capricorn schedules a feelings meeting
old_caption: Capricorn sent a calendar invite titled FEELINGS with an agenda attached, then froze on the blank slide. The unscripted part went better. Would you accept this meeting?

title: Aquarius invents a heated bench
old_caption: Aquarius built a heated bench to solve winter for everyone, when it mostly wanted one person to sit down. And then the first snow showed up. What would you invent to avoid saying it out loud?

title: Pisces cries at the first snow
old_caption: Pisces cried at a snowflake, then a snowman, then deleted a two-word text. The snow got a reply before Pisces did. What's the text you keep typing and never sending?

title: The double date
old_caption: One couple skates in perfect sync with matching mugs. The other apologised three times in ten seconds. Fun fact: the smooth ones started with someone in a fountain. Which pair is your group chat?

title: Are we cuffed or just cold?
old_caption: Sag and Aquarius added a scarf, a second blanket and a third, all for science. One honest question did what three blankets couldn't. Are you cuffed or just cold?

title: The matching mittens
old_caption: Capricorn rehearsed a gift speech on a snowman until its nose fell off. The real speech was one line long, and Cancer had knitted a scarf anyway. Tag the friend who over-rehearses.

title: Who texts first when it's freezing
old_caption: Scorpio thinks texting first means losing. Taurus thinks it means too much. Two hours of drafts later they sent the same text in the same second. Who usually breaks first, you or them?

title: The ex shows up with cocoa
old_caption: The ex brought cocoa and the snow-day memories. Libra said thank you, said no, and still sounded kind. Gemini left with both mugs, which seems fair. What's your kindest no?

title: The friend who's single and fine
old_caption: The friends showed up with a mystery card, a someone, and a lot of pity. Virgo showed up with soup, a puzzle and a full life. Soup night won. Who's the Virgo of your friend group?
